title: 8 Things a Godly Man Does Before He Opens His Inbox
caption:
The first hour sets the tone God gets, or doesn't get, for the rest of your day.

Most men give it to their inbox by default. A godly man decides on purpose.

None of these eight things involve checking email first. All eight are available to you tomorrow morning.

Pick one. Start there.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #work #discipline
